name: apply_artifact_patch
description: Modify the hosted Artifact of the current WebUI session with a patch; the same preview resource is updated automatically. Read existing files with read_artifact before modifying them; patch paths may only be plain filenames from the Artifact manifest. Supports Add File, Update File, and Delete File; directories and path moves are not supported.

patchText.description: Full patch text, wrapped in *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch. Paths in file headers must be plain Artifact filenames, e.g. *** Update File: report.md.
